identificationModule.briefTitle: A Single-arm Phase II Clinical Study of Camrelizumab Combined With Long-course Chemoradiotherapy for Total Neoadjuvant Therapy in Locally Advanced Low pMMR/MSS Rectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Single-arm Phase II Clinical Study of Camrelizumab Combined With Long-course Chemoradiotherapy for Total Neoadjuvant Therapy in Locally Advanced Low pMMR/MSS Rectal Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: In pMMR/MSS locally advanced rectal cancer, can the innovative "chemo-immunotherapy induction + LCRT + chemo-immunotherapy consolidation" approach significantly improve the complete response rate and create opportunities for organ preservation?

interventions.name: Camrelizumab
interventions.description: patients first receive 2 cycles of camrelizumab combined with CAPOX (capecitabine 1000 mg/m² orally twice daily on days 1-14; oxaliplatin 130 mg/m² intravenously every 3 weeks). This is followed by long-course chemoradiotherapy (LCRT): a total dose of 50.4 Gy delivered in 28 fractions, with concurrent capecitabine 825 mg/m² orally twice daily.

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: cCR is assessed at 4-6 weeks post-therapy by imaging/endoscopy; pCR is assessed postoperatively (surgery at 4-6 weeks post-therapy + pathology within 1-2 weeks after surgery).
